Hi Attila — thanks for sending those over. Quick answers and next steps below.

Short answer: For B2B services to our EU entity, we expect to apply the reverse-charge (no VAT on Redwood invoice) provided we have a valid EU VAT number for the vendor and the billing entity on our side is an EU legal entity.

What we need from you to activate a PO:
- PDF of the VAT registration (we have it, thanks). If available, an English/translated page that shows the UID clearly, that helps finance.
- Completed supplier onboarding form (I've attached the vendor form template) — includes legal name, registered address, VAT number, bank details, contact person.
- Official invoice example (sample invoice) that shows the vendor VAT number and a service description in English.

Internal note: Laura / Ben — please confirm if Redwood should be billed net (reverse-charge) or if we must record supplier VAT on the PO for tax reporting. If we go net, finance will set the tax code to RC-EU on the vendor master.

Attila — once Laura confirms, I'll issue a vendor-creation request and we can target PO creation by Feb 19.

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Attila — apologies for the delay and thanks for the patience. A few confirmations from finance and payments:

1) Tax treatment: We will apply reverse-charge (no VAT charged on Redwood invoices) for B2B services between PixelWave Kft (HU) and Redwood's EU billing entity. Please ensure your VAT number (HU12345678) is shown on all invoices. We will record the transaction with tax code RC-EU in SAP.

2) Required docs: We have the VAT certificate you supplied — please also send:
   - a scanned, signed copy of the completed Redwood supplier onboarding form (signed_onboarding_form.pdf),
   - one sample invoice in English that includes the VAT number and a clear service description,
   - confirmation of the legal billing entity name (must match VAT record).

3) Vendor creation & PO: Irene will create the vendor in SAP once we receive the completed onboarding form and sample invoice. We will then raise a standard PO (net value, tax code RC-EU). Target PO issuance: Feb 19, pending receipt of the above.

4) Payments: Once vendor is live, normal 30-day terms will apply. For bank details we only accept IBAN + SWIFT for HU accounts — the file you sent is fine, but payments will not be released until vendor validation completes.

Next steps for PixelWave: return the completed onboarding form (signed) and a sample invoice. Irena (cc) will confirm vendor creation when done.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Finance Ops Lead — Redwood Inference
